description: State Ministry of wildlife Protection - Regulations Under Section 22A of the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance (Chaptor 469)
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made under the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance, establishing legal requirements for the protection and well-being of tamed elephants. It creates new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for elephant owners, including specific prohibitions, mandatory practices, and enforcement mechanisms. While it mentions a State Minister (Wimalaweera Dissanayaka), this is only in the context of the regulatory authority making the regulations, not as a personnel appointment or portfolio assignment. The core content is purely legal/regulatory in nature.
